_note: D-EDGELESS-NODE-INVISIBLE-TO-THE-GRAPH-READ through the real chat path. The node is SEEDED so the turn arrives at a project whose store holds an entity and whose graph has no edges — the ordinary state of 440 of the 455 projects on this instance.

scenarios.prompt: Show the graph — what is in this project's knowledge graph?
scenarios.prompt_source: kg_graph_query's OWN declared synonyms, verbatim: 'show the graph' + 'knowledge graph'.
scenarios.approve_why: READ intent, Tier-R tool under test. Approving a write on a turn that only asked to look would make the harness the thing that wrote.

seed.why: 🔴 THE NODE MUST BE EDGELESS, AND IT CANNOT BE ANYTHING ELSE. kg_add_nodes mode=manual creates ONE node and placing an edge needs an approved confirm card, so every node this fixture can make is isolated — which is the defect's own precondition, not a contrivance. Seeded rather than created by the turn so the model arrives holding nothing.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: kg_graph_query returns nodes: [] for a project whose store holds this entity, OR meta.nodes_total is 0, OR the model reports that the graph/project is empty or that nothing has been established — the false-absence relay this defect produces. Store check: the graph is a READ, so the entity count must stay at 1 and no edge may appear.

ship_audit.gate: N/A — Tier R, no confirm card.
ship_audit.absent_case: a project with no entities at all must still return nodes: [] with nodes_total 0 — that zero is TRUE and is not what this measures.
ship_audit.tenancy: the isolated read binds user_id + project_id and skips archived, the same partition predicates as the edge read; unit-guarded.

answer_expect.why: The name can only have come from the graph read — it is not in the prompt. A reply that discusses the graph in the abstract proves nothing, which is why the bar is the entity's own name.
